subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require a live packaged Linux gateway reproduction before any cap or Skill Workshop persistence fix is attempted for this issue?
rationale: The obvious source caps are much higher than the reported cutoff, and the Skill Workshop symptom depends on proposal id/name/workspace state that is not in the issue body.

options.title: Require live reproduction first
options.body: Keep this issue open with manual review until a packaged Linux gateway run captures raw transcript/config/proposal evidence for the exact failing path.

options.title: Split overlapping cap tracks
options.body: Route read-only cap policy to the existing related issues while preserving this issue for exec/web and Skill Workshop evidence.

options.title: Sponsor cap-policy work now
options.body: A maintainer can choose to align visible/progress caps with toolResultMaxChars before full reproduction, accepting compatibility and memory-risk tradeoffs.

recommendation.title: Require live reproduction first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open with manual review until a packaged Linux gateway run captures raw transcript/config/proposal evidence for the exact failing path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest recent history across the read, tool-result truncation, and visible delivery paths implicated by the report.
